segments.text: Bryan Johnson and I have never slept together, even though we've been dating for 4 years. It's because the science suggests that some people sleep better with partners next to them and others don't. So so far, we've been prioritizing our sleep quality and sleeping separately, but that's about to change. I'm going to challenge him to spending three nights in bed with me to see what happens to both our sleep quality when we sleep next to each other. I'm excited for the cuddles, but I'm also kind of scared that my sleep quality is just going to tank. His is going to get better, and then I'm going to be on the hook for sleeping next to him every night. We'll see what happens.

I'm going to share all the results with you online for free. I've loved having my own space, my own bed, and being able to control all my environment. I'm excited to see what happens. Is it going to be good or bad for us? We'll find out.
